title: Taekwondo Stance and Footwork
description:
1. Clear enough space to move safely and take a balanced starting position for Taekwondo Stance and Footwork.
2. Stay light in a balanced fighting stance and use short slides, steps, and pivots without crossing the feet.
3. Work in the air or on pads with control, reset to guard after each repetition, and continue until the interval ends.
